newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens prosecutor to investigate bourse crisis.
newsitem.headline: Athens prosecutor to investigate bourse crisis.

text.p: An urgent investigation has been ordered into the Athens bourse settlement crisis, the head of the Athens prosecutor's office, Anastasios Kanellopoulos, told Reuters.
He said prosecutor George Koliokostas had been appointed to look into the bourse settlement row and Delta Securities which was barred from trade on Thursday.
Athens stock exchange member brokerages voted to boycott trading on Friday until the clearing house guaranteed settlement.
Some exchange members said the clearing house had failed to pay some members on Thursday.
Delta Securities was barred from trade on Thursday for non-compliance with settlement regulations.

Neither Delta nor the clearing house has been available for comment. Bourse President Manolis Xanthakis has cut short his trip to Hong Kong to return to Athens to face the crisis, his office said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
